camel_example: aliyun cloudfw CreateApplicationTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --CustomRuleStatus Enable --UnknownAction Alert --ApplicationTemplateName '应用程序模板01' --BuiltInApplicationStatus Enable --TemplateStatus Enable
description_en: Creates an application program template. The template is at the user granularity and can be referenced by the access control policy for the Internet border, NAT, and virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Before creating a template, ensure that the application program control feature is enabled and the number of templates does not exceed the quota for the instance specifications
description_zh: 创建应用程序模板。模板为用户粒度，可被互联网、NAT、VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略引用。创建前需已开通应用程序管控功能，且模板数量未超过实例规格配额
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-application-template --application-template-name '应用程序模板01' --template-status Enable --built-in-application-status Enable --custom-rule-status Enable --unknown-action Alert --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplicationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the application template. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). It cannot contain spaces or be empty
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.），不能包含空格，不能为空
parameters.name: application_template_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the application template. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be empty
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板的描述信息。长度不超过128个字符，可以为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The overall switch status of the application template. Valid values:
Enable: Enables the template.
Disable: Disables the template
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序模板总开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en: The switch status of built-in application control. Only Enable is supported, which indicates that built-in application control is enabled. If you pass Disable, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 内置应用管控开关状态。取值仅支持Enable，表示开启内置应用管控；传入Disable会返回错误
parameters.name: built_in_application_status

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of custom application rules. Valid values:
Enable: Enables the feature.
Disable: Disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序自定义规则开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: custom_rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on unidentified applications. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the traffic.
Alert: Monitors the traffic.
Deny: Blocks the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
未识别应用的处置动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
parameters.name: unknown_action

fields.help_en:
The action to perform on the application. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the traffic.
Alert: Monitors the traffic.
Deny: Blocks the traffic
fields.help_zh:
对该应用程序执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The ID of the application for which you want to configure a custom action. The application must exist in the built-in application signature library and the ID cannot be 0. You can call the ListApplications operation to query the ID
fields.help_zh: 要设置自定义动作的应用程序ID。必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用，不能为0。可通过ListApplications查询
fields.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The list of custom actions to configure for built-in applications. The application IDs in the list must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 为内置应用设置自定义动作的列表。列表内应用程序ID不可重复
parameters.name: add_built_in_application_custom_actions

ApplicationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the newly created application template
